description: The Usage page exposes many daily chart bars as individual buttons, creating a very large tab/screen-reader surface.
expected: The chart should remain inspectable without overwhelming keyboard and screen-reader navigation.
actual: The accessibility tree contains dozens of separate buttons named like "Usage for Sun, Sep 28, 2025".
suggested_fix: Review the chart interaction model and consider roving focus, grouped chart semantics, or a summarised accessible table/detail pattern.
